_notes.workers: one trusted worker process (and its own zygote) per CPU; each verifies one completion at a time
_notes.lanes: weight = share of workers while both lanes have work; capacity = queued completions before 429
_notes.require_full_isolation: refuse to start unless network namespace, uid drop and private tmp all work
_notes.watchdog_grace_s: a worker still busy wall_s + this many seconds after starting a job is killed and replaced
